text: Reyrolle 7SR46 is a CT-powered overcurrent protection relay with the option for an external auxiliary power supply. This panel-mounted numeric relay provides both definite-time and inverse-time overcurrent and earth-fault protection for distribution grid applications such as cable networks and Ring Main Units (RMU). Reyrolle 7SR46 integrates with SCADA systems. Its compact, easy-to-use front panel includes navigation keys, an LCD and USB port.
heading: Why Reyrolle 7SR46?

text: Instantaneous and delayed overcurrent protection functions
